note: 🔴 REQ-112 §R. TWO halves. (1) THE UNDO NEVER TOUCHES THE EXPIRY: U1 gives a week back · U2 records an expiry change · U4 re-introduces the actor check (the REQ-114 (ii) self-block) · U3 re-introduces the `UNDO_LEAVE_CHARGE_UNKNOWN` refusal · U5 refunds a free declared day · U6 never gives the count back · U7/U8 the chain refusal loses its steps / turns its STOP branch into a path (Khwan's Peeta case). (2) THE ADMIN IS TOLD when a make-up lands past the expiry, once per make-up: N1 warns about EVERY make-up · N2 sends twice · N3–N7 each re-plan caller stops asking (each bites ALONE — the proof the callers' list is complete) · N8 asks BEFORE the week (a false alarm the week already covers) · N9 replaces `makeup_far_out` instead of sitting beside it · N10 the check stretches the expiry again (the silent stretch-to-fit, in its third home) · N11 the Thai copy is paraphrased. 🔻 2026-10-06, TASK-692 (REQ-112 re-cut): N5 (door 2 stops asking), N7 (door 1 stops asking) and N8 (door 1 asks before its week) are RETIRED — their SUBJECT is gone: doors 1 and 2 (a FAMILY leave) now REFUSE through `assertRoomForLeave` instead of flagging, so the `flagMakeupsPastExpiry` lines they edited no longer exist there. Their successors are in `leave-refused-no-validity-task692.mutations.json` (the refusal removed · asked before the T1 week). N3/N4/N6 (doors 4, 3, 5) keep their subject and bite.
